sources.locator: "Chinese Civil War", revision 1375954779, § First United Front

explanation: The civil war’s article begins its account at the Qing collapse and the republic the revolution made. The article reads: "Following the collapse of the Qing dynasty and the 1911 Revolution, Sun Yat-sen assumed the presidency of the newly formed Republic of China (ROC), and was shortly thereafter succeeded by Yuan Shikai."
